title: Refreshed Tech Reborn
description: A resource pack made to improve  textures from Tech Reborn.
body:
![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdaae433fb03dc1eb947add7141a5b73e4f7627a.png)A resource pack made to improve  textures from Tech Reborn.
-Every set of tools match the vanilla now
-New textures to all Metals (ingots,nuggets,plates,storage blocks) 
-New Pump Texture 
-Feel free to include this resource pack in your modpack
